ModMetaData.name: StallTrace17 - Waylith Pawn Stall Diagnostics
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI-assisted
ModMetaData.description: Independent measurement-only diagnostic for RimWorld 1.7 Waylith (.NET 10). Captures slow frame, tick, pawn, job search, work scan, job driver and pathfinding spans. Detects 10+ same-tick StartJob loops. Exports bounded reports to the user profile. No gameplay logic is changed. This is a reconstructed 1.7 successor; the StallTrace16 original source was not accessible for a byte-for-byte port.
